u60f72d12cc: After SDK development is complete, it is often necessary to change the prompt tones, the Bluetooth name configuration and so on, in order to adapt quickly to adjustments of the SDK solution and to production.
u3ab1fb9740: The purpose of this tool is to help project managers quickly modify information such as the prompt tones and the Bluetooth name configuration in product firmware files.

u5a6c7eb05f: The ⟦1⟧edit_cfg.ini⟦/1⟧ file is designed to let project managers specify which files in the firmware file can be modified and which cannot.
uafcf92e41d: The contents of the ⟦1⟧edit_cfg.ini⟦/1⟧ file are as follows; you can copy them directly into the SDK.
u73bf942b94:
[EDIT_PERMISSION]
;Whether modification is allowed, true by default
ENABLE = 

[FLASH_BIN]
;Blacklist: files that may not be modified
BLACK_LIST = 

;Other files that may be replaced
REPLACE_LIST = 

[FW]
;Reserved-area resources in the FW file that may be replaced
RESERVED_LIST = 
				
[UFW]
;Reserved-area resources in the UFW file that may be replaced
RESERVED_LIST =

ud4d86c0f69: The purpose of this tool is to help project managers quickly modify the Bluetooth address, Bluetooth name and authentication code in products that have already been programmed.
u0e11934811: This tool supports the following modes for connecting to products:
u421a222792: This mode can be used only when the product itself is not connected to a power supply.⟦1/⟧ In this mode, you do not need to select the chip type or whether there is a power supply; the device type is detected automatically once the product is connected with the Forced Upgrade Tool, as shown below:
u799b273909: In this mode, you must manually select the chip type used by the product.⟦1/⟧ This mode requires the ⟦2⟧serial port upgrade⟦/2⟧ function of the Forced Upgrade Tool.⟦3/⟧ The "With power supply" (有电源) option is an optional setting for products that have their own power supply; selecting it speeds up communication. (This requires support in the SDK; if the SDK does not support it, opening fails.)
u2dbaea588b: The "Auto update" (自动更新) option writes the Bluetooth address, Bluetooth name or authentication code to the product immediately after it is modified.
u116791db48: The "Auto read after update" (更新后自动读取) option automatically reads back the corresponding information after the Bluetooth address, Bluetooth name or authentication code is updated, so that you can check whether it was changed correctly.
uf19bb097d2: The "Auto read" (自动读取) option automatically reads the corresponding information after the product is opened.
ufcc3ed129e: The "Manual input" (手动输入) option determines whether the input cursor is reset periodically. When it is checked, the input cursor is not reset periodically. Leave it unchecked when using a barcode scanner.
u75170b2045: The "Auto reset" (自动复位) option determines whether the product is reset automatically after the Bluetooth address, Bluetooth name or authentication code is updated.
u56d03de3b9: With the "Mark duplicates" (重复标记) option, the Bluetooth address or authentication code that is read is saved to read.xlsx in the tool's directory, and duplicates are highlighted in red. Note that when this option is checked, "Query" (查询), "Auto query" (自动查询) and "Auto read after update" (更新后自动读取) all save the information to read.xlsx. So if "Auto read after update" is checked, do not also click the "Query" button or check "Auto query", to avoid duplicate entries.
u9f5ce939d6: The "Query Bluetooth address and authentication code" (查询蓝牙地址和认证码) option allows the Bluetooth address and the authentication code to be queried together during a query or auto query.
ud34619f9a0: With the "Update all" (全部更新) option, all 6 bytes of the Bluetooth address are updated; with "Update low bytes" (低位更新), only the low 3 bytes of the Bluetooth address are updated.
u66d3eef73b: With the "Auto-increment update" (自增更新) option, the Bluetooth address is automatically incremented by 1 after each update, so you do not need to change it manually. (This has no effect once a Bluetooth address file is selected.)
u36fc3621ac: When a Bluetooth address file is selected, Bluetooth addresses are updated automatically in the order in which they appear in the file. (The "Auto-increment update" option has no effect.)
u286fcfcd93: In the Bluetooth address file, the first column of the first row must be "MACADDRESS" or the Chinese header (蓝牙地址), and the second column of the first row must be "USED" or the Chinese header (是否已使用).⟦1/⟧ From the second row on, the first column contains the Bluetooth address and the second column contains a flag indicating whether the Bluetooth address in that row has been used. The format is shown below:
ub673a53c79: With the "Auto-increment update" (自增更新) option, after each update the last digit of the Bluetooth name is automatically incremented by 1, or the last letter changes to the next letter, so you do not need to change the Bluetooth name manually. (This has no effect once a Bluetooth name file is selected.)
u300c193cd9: When a Bluetooth name file is selected, Bluetooth names are updated automatically in the order in which they appear in the file. (The "Auto-increment update" option has no effect.)
u7dda574335: In the Bluetooth name file, the first column of the first row must be "BT_NAME" or the Chinese header (蓝牙名), and the second column of the first row must be "USED" or the Chinese header (是否已使用).⟦1/⟧ From the second row on, the first column contains the Bluetooth name and the second column contains a flag indicating whether the Bluetooth name in that row has been used. The format is shown below:
